nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 17 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine four independent current-day observations reported between 00:30 and 12:00 WAT and rechecked at 13:27 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 17 Nov (latest dated table).

Kenya.note: CBK Daily KES commercial-banks' average closing rates, posted 18 Nov; not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 17 Nov; latest verified publication carried forward with its true effective date.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 17 Nov; latest verified publication carried forward with its true effective date.

markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana mid of Bank of Ghana buy/sell (17 Nov, latest dated table); Kenya CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates posted 18 Nov (not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB 17 Nov (carried forward); Egypt CBE 17 Nov (carried forward).
nigeria_market_note: Four independent current-day observations dated 18 Nov were combined. USD, GBP and EUR exceed the dispersion gate; the corroborated ranges are retained with documented reasons rather than forcing single quotes.
method: premium_pct = (parallel buying midpoint / CBN selling rate - 1) x 100
parallel_source: Aggregated from multiple independent market sources
